newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bulls, pop, sport pay more than Colombia presidency.
newsitem.headline: Bulls, pop, sport pay more than Colombia presidency.

text.p: Colombia's President Ernesto Samper earns 25 times less than the country's most successful bullfighter but four times more than a hard-working prostitute, according to a survey of earnings published Sunday.

Among the highest paid Colombians are premier matador Cesar Rincon, who earns about $160,000 a month, and 19-year-old pop star Shakira, who nets about the same amount, according to the influential weekly magazine Semana.
Samper's monthly wages amount to about $6,500, while a hard-working prostitute can take in about $1,400 a month, Semana said.

The survey did not take account of the country's business elite, whose earnings are a closely guarded secret. Nor did it look at Colombia's notorious drug barons, who have amassed multi- million fortunes.

Other high-flyers named in the article were soccer striker Faustino Asprilla, of Britain's Newscastle United, who banks a $120,000 paycheck each month and Florida Marlins baseball star Edgar Renteria, who picks up a cool $25,000 per month.
The minimum monthly wage in Colombia, meanwhile, is just $140. Firefighters earn about $500 for putting their lives on the line while a housekeeper may earn $200 a month.
